notes.title: Version 0.4.0 !
notes.notes:
80% More Performance!
 Bugs in network and game fixed!
 FPS mode temporarily removed.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Musics!
notes.notes:
- Network bug fixes
- Add background musics!
- New UFO in Industrial Map

notes.title: Version 0.3.0 is live!
notes.notes:
- Faster and more beautiful!
 - Added auto exposure on some maps to improve visibility in dark areas and provide more realism.
 - Fixed slow performance issue that caused the game to close upon opening.
 - Added new achievements.
 - Aliens now also receive critical damage when shot in the head.
 - Upon completing the mission of the map, the game ends (previously, it was only ending on time).

notes.title: v 0.2.4 Bug fix that causes a crash on startup!
notes.notes: I'm trying to implement the ranking feature within the game, but this function is causing the game to crash upon opening on some computers. I'm fixing this; hopefully, version 0.2.4 resolves this issue!
